text:
erin: Dropped a relnotes draft for the routing + batching changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/811. Can someone quick-check snippets, deprecation notes, and a short known-issues bullet?

gabe: On it. Quick flag: the dep graph still mentions `redis-prefix-cache`. We replaced that with `unified-kv-cache` in Dedicated v0.9. Recommend a deprecation callout + migration link.

hana: Snippet sanity: PY and JS use `model: 'kestrel'` in examples. Should be `kestrel-v2` now. I'll open a tiny PR to fix both.

oliver: Support asked for a brief line in the routing table about fallback behavior so they have a canonical paste. Suggested: "During autoscale warm-up, requests may be routed to compatible smaller variants; pin `model_variant` to avoid this."

erin: Good. Plan: (1) add deprecation callout for `redis-prefix-cache`, (2) swap snippets to `kestrel-v2`, (3) add known-issue bullet with INF-3124, (4) run linkcheck.

l10n-bot: Reminder: if you want JP/EU pages included in the release, please add i18n stubs under `/i18n/{locale}/relnotes/` before the content freeze.

gabe: Running linkcheck: `./tools/linkcheck docs/relnotes --report=artifacts/links-relnotes.json`. Will post results here.

hana: PR #812 opened to update snippets to `kestrel-v2` and standardize `model=` param. Includes snippet-render unit test.

oliver: Draft known-issue wording (pasteable):
```
Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback variants during cold starts under high concurrency
- Mitigation: pin `model_variant` on Dedicated routes or increase warm-pool size
- Tracking: INF-3124
```

erin: Adding that verbatim and linking to INF-3124 in the KB pointer.

gabe: Linkcheck output: 2 broken anchors, 1 external redirect. I'll open a tiny PR for anchors and suggest redirect notes for the external link.

hana: I'll hold the JP stub until anchors are stable. Path will be `/i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md`. If localization misses the window we'll ship EN and follow up.

erin: Gabe, please paste broken anchor list in the PR description so we can vend redirects where needed. For the external redirect, prefer adding a short caveat rather than changing the canonical URL.

gabe: PR #813 created for anchor fixes + redirect suggestions. CI flagged a flaky renderer test; re-run queued.

l10n-bot: Note: translation slots are limited this sprint. Mark priority if you need same-day localization.

hana: PR #812 merged by hana  snippets updated.

gabe: PR #813 merged. Linkcheck green on staging.

erin: Final pre-publish checklist:
- [x] Deprecation note for `redis-prefix-cache` added
- [x] Snippets updated (PY/JS) to `kestrel-v2`
- [x] Known-issue block added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck green on staging
- [ ] JP localization pending (hana)

hana: I'll open the JP stub PR within the next 3 hours. If it misses the cutoff we'll ship EN and follow up with JP the following day.

erin: Thanks all. I'll schedule the docs publish and post the announcement here for review before sending. :rocket:
